input.quote: 12.3 Nothing restricts Customer from developing, acquiring, licensing, selling, or using any product or service, engaging any supplier, hiring any person who responds to general recruitment, or conducting business in any field or territory. Vendor acknowledges that Customer has made no exclusivity, non-compete, most-favoured-customer, minimum-volume, or no-hire commitment.
input.rationale: No covenant anywhere in the Agreement restricts Customer's businesses, products, fields or territories. Section 12.3 expressly confirms the opposite: Customer is free to develop, acquire, license, sell or use any product or service, engage any supplier and operate in any field or territory, and has made no exclusivity or non-compete commitment. The only competition-related restraints run against Brightline (12.4 — Vendor shall not develop or market a directly competing service during the term; 24 — Vendor may not assign to a Customer competitor), which benefit us and are not flagged. Licence-related restrictions in 13.4 are ordinary anti-reverse-engineering/misuse limits with statutory and security-testing carve-outs, not field-of-use or competitive restraints. Preferred position (no non-compete or field-of-use restriction on Customer) is met; no redline needed.
